# exo_partner_application (Data Source)

Look up an existing PartnerApplication object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `accept_security_identifier_information` (Boolean) Maps to the -AcceptSecurityIdentifierInformation parameter.
- `account_type` (String) Maps to the -AccountType parameter.
- `act_as_permissions` (Set of String) Maps to the -ActAsPermissions parameter.
- `application_identifier` (String) Maps to the -ApplicationIdentifier parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `linked_account` (String) Maps to the -LinkedAccount parameter.
